subtitle: When the Eastern Hills Answered Harsha’s Call

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of a royal envoy standing between Harsha’s court and misty eastern hills
panels.action: Hangsavega, cloaked in fine silk and travel-worn dust, stands at the threshold of a grand North Indian court, one hand lifted in respectful greeting, while behind him rise misty, forested hills hinting at distant Kamarupa.

dialogue.text: In the restless age of Harsha, when Gauda watched from the shadows, an envoy named Hangsavega carried Bhaskaravarman’s eastern answer to the struggle for the North.

i18n.hi: हर्ष के बेक़रार दौर में, जब गौड़ छाया से देख रहा था, हंसवेग नाम का दूत, भास्करवर्मन का पूर्वी जवाब लेकर उत्तर की जंग में उतरा।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot over the plains of North India at dawn
panels.action: The sun rises over the northern plains, faint mist hugging the rivers and fields, as distant silhouettes of cities and monastic complexes suggest a land awakening after war.

dialogue.text: Around 606, North India stood at a turning. The Maukhari line had broken, Harsha rose in their place, and Gauda’s king Shashanka watched with sharp, troubled eyes.

i18n.hi: लगभग ६०६ में, उत्तर भारत चौराहे पर था। मौखरी टूट चुके थे, उनकी जगह हर्ष उठा, और गौड़ का राजा शशांक तेज़, बेचैन निगाहों से देख रहा था।

panels.shot: medium aerial over a stylised map showing Thanesar, Gauda, Kamarupa and the Brahmaputra
panels.action: A parchment map lies spread, rivers like inked serpents: Thanesar and Kannauj at the centre, Gauda to the east, Kamarupa beyond forests and hills along the Brahmaputra.

dialogue.text: Between the Ganga and the Brahmaputra, three powers weighed each other. Harsha’s new house, Gauda’s old challenge, and Kamarupa in the humid hills beyond the eastern forests.

i18n.hi: गंगा और ब्रह्मपुत्र के बीच तीन ताक़तें एक-दूसरे को तौल रही थीं — हर्ष का नया घराना, गौड़ की पुरानी चुनौती, और पूरब के जंगलों के पार नमी से भरे पहाड़ों में कामरूप।

panels.shot: medium interior shot of Bhaskaravarman in council, seated yet alert
panels.action: Bhaskaravarman sits on a modest but dignified throne, youthful and sharp-eyed, courtiers flanking him, palm-leaf documents and copper plates laid before him in a wooden hall open to dense greenery.

dialogue.text: In Kamarupa, the young Bhaskaravarman, later named in the Nidhanpur plates, faced the same question from the hills: how to live between Harsha’s ascent and Gauda’s ambitions.

i18n.hi: कामरूप में नौजवान भास्करवर्मन, जिसे बाद में निधानपुर ताम्रपत्रों में याद किया गया, उसी पहाड़ी सवाल से जूझ रहा था — हर्ष की चढ़त और गौड़ की चाहतों के बीच कैसे जिएं।

panels.shot: close-up on Bhaskaravarman’s thoughtful face, candlelight flickering
panels.action: A close-up of Bhaskaravarman’s face in lamplight, brows slightly furrowed as he studies a copper plate inscription, the engraved letters glinting faintly.

dialogue.speaker: bhaskaravarman
dialogue.text: If the plains burn, the smoke reaches our hills.

i18n.hi: मैदानों में आग लगे, धुआँ तो हमारे पहाड़ तक आएगा ही।

panels.shot: medium shot of Bhaskaravarman addressing assembled ministers and scribes
panels.action: Bhaskaravarman gestures toward a rough board with pebbles marking Thanesar, Gauda and Kamarupa, ministers listening intently in a hall where monsoon rain beats on the tiled roof.

dialogue.text: Shashanka of Gauda pressed west, Harsha gathered allies to check him. From Kamarupa, Bhaskaravarman chose not to wait for armies to arrive at his river crossings.

i18n.hi: गौड़ का शशांक पश्चिम की ओर धकेल रहा था, हर्ष उसे रोकने को साथी जुटा रहा था। कामरूप के भास्करवर्मन ने तय किया कि सेनाओं के नदी तक पहुँचने का इंतज़ार नहीं करेगा।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Bhaskaravarman leaning forward as he selects an envoy
panels.action: Bhaskaravarman leans forward from his seat, eyes fixed on a tall, calm officer standing before him, as the court falls silent in expectation.

dialogue.text: Banabhatta’s Harshacharita remembers the moment simply: Bhaskaravarman sent an envoy named Hangsavega to Harsha, carrying the hills’ decision toward the plains.

i18n.hi: बाणभट्ट की ‘हर्षचरित’ उस क्षण को सीधा-सा याद करती है — भास्करवर्मन ने हर्ष के पास हंसवेग नाम का दूत भेजा, जो पहाड़ों का फ़ैसला मैदानों तक ले गया।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind Bhaskaravarman as he gestures toward the east, Hangsavega bowing
panels.action: Seen from behind Bhaskaravarman’s shoulder, we see him extend his hand toward the western horizon while a dignified envoy bows deeply, ready to depart.

dialogue.speaker: bhaskaravarman
dialogue.text: Go to Harsha. Let our words walk before our warriors.

i18n.hi: हर्ष के पास जाओ। हमारे शब्द, हमारे योद्धाओं से पहले चलें।

panels.shot: wide shot of a caravan moving through dense eastern forest
panels.action: A long caravan winds through thick forest, pack animals laden with chests and wrapped bundles, attendants in varied dress guiding them along a narrow path beside a rushing stream.

dialogue.text: From Kamarupa’s valleys, Hangsavega led a train of gifts and letters. Through forest, rain and river, diplomacy took the slower, older road east to west.

i18n.hi: कामरूप की वादियों से हंसवेग उपहारों और पत्रों की क़तार लेकर निकला। जंगल, बरसात और नदियों को पार करते हुए पूर्व से पश्चिम कूटनीति ने धीमी, पुरानी राह पकड़ी।

panels.shot: detailed medium shot on a laden pack animal, highlighting different gifts
panels.action: A close view of a pack animal’s load shows tightly rolled silk, a pouch of musk, bundles of aromatic resins, finely woven mats, and a stack of bark manuscripts bound with cord.

dialogue.text: The list survives in recollection and parallel accounts: silk and aromatics, musk from the hills, mats from the eastern craftspersons, and manuscripts written on sachi bark.

i18n.hi: सूची यादों और समान वृत्तांतों में बची है — रेशमी कपड़े और सुगंध, पहाड़ों की कस्तूरी, पूरब के कारीगरों की चटाइयाँ, और साची की छाल पर लिखी पांडुलिपियाँ।

panels.shot: medium shot of Hangsavega crossing a broad river by boat
panels.action: Hangsavega stands steady on a wooden boat crossing a wide river, wind tugging his cloak as oarsmen pull hard, low hills fading behind and flat plains rising ahead.

dialogue.text: At every ford and ferry, Gauda’s shadow hung over the journey. Yet Hangsavega’s task was clear: turn that shadow into a shared concern with Harsha.

i18n.hi: हर घाट और नावघाट पर, गौड़ की परछाईं सफ़र पर झुकी थी। फिर भी हंसवेग का काम साफ़ था — उस परछाईं को हर्ष के साथ साझा फ़िक्र में बदल देना।

panels.shot: epic long shot of Harsha’s camp or early capital with banners and elephants
panels.action: A sprawling royal camp spreads across the plain, elephants tethered under trees, banners fluttering, soldiers and scribes moving between canvas pavilions as smoke from cooking fires curls upward.

dialogue.text: By the time Hangsavega reached Harsha, the young ruler was still knitting together the lands left raw by 606, balancing campaigns with councils and the building of trust.

i18n.hi: जब तक हंसवेग हर्ष तक पहुँचा, नौजवान शासक अब भी ६०६ के घाव लगे इलाकों को जोड़ रहा था — लड़ाइयों, दरबारों और भरोसा बनाने के बीच संतुलन साधता हुआ।

panels.shot: interior wide of Harsha’s audience tent, with courtiers assembled
panels.action: Inside a large pavilion, richly patterned carpets line the floor, ministers and generals sit in ordered rows, and at the far end a simple but elevated seat waits for Harsha’s approach.

dialogue.text: Banabhatta crafts the scene with flourish, but the core is firm: a foreign envoy entered Harsha’s hall, bringing an offer that would redraw the eastern balance.

i18n.hi: बाणभट्ट दृश्य को सजाकर लिखता है, पर मूल बात अडिग है — एक बाहरी दूत हर्ष के सभागार में घुसा, ऐसा प्रस्ताव लेकर जो पूरे पूर्वी संतुलन को पलट सकता था।

panels.shot: medium shot from low angle on Hangsavega bowing before a seated Harsha (Harsha implied off-frame), gifts stacked nearby
panels.action: From a low angle, we see Hangsavega in mid-bow toward an unseen ruler, chests and bundles piled respectfully to one side, courtiers watching with keen, measuring eyes.

dialogue.text: In Harshacharita, Hangsavega speaks for his king, aligning Kamarupa’s fortunes with Harsha’s resolve, and presenting Bhaskaravarman as ally against Gauda’s Shashanka.

i18n.hi: ‘हर्षचरित’ में हंसवेग अपने राजा की ओर से बोलता है — कामरूप की किस्मत को हर्ष के इरादे से जोड़ते हुए, भास्करवर्मन को गौड़ के शशांक के ख़िलाफ़ साथी के रूप में पेश करता है।

panels.shot: close-up on a manuscript being unrolled before the throne
panels.action: Delicate hands unroll a bark manuscript before the throne, its lines of script neat and dark, as a court scribe leans closer to read and interpret.

dialogue.text: No verbatim speech survives, only Bana’s ornate re-imagining. Yet behind his words lies a clear contract: mutual support, shared worry over Gauda, and an eastern door opened.

i18n.hi: उनके मुँह के शब्द तो नहीं बचे, बस बाण की सजी हुई कल्पना है। पर उसके पीछे साफ़ समझौता झलकता है — परस्पर सहारा, गौड़ को लेकर साझा चिंता, और पूरब का एक दरवाज़ा खुला हुआ।

panels.shot: medium shot of Harsha (implied figure) lifting one of the gifts, such as silk, with measured appreciation
panels.action: A royal hand—decorated but not ostentatious—lifts a folded silk cloth, while courtiers look on; in the background the other gifts remain neatly arranged on low platforms.

dialogue.text: Gifts did more than flatter. Silk and musk hinted at routes and resources; manuscripts and mats spoke of craftsmen, monasteries and scribes tied to Bhaskaravarman’s house.

i18n.hi: उपहार सिर्फ़ खुशामद नहीं थे। रेशम और कस्तूरी ने रास्तों और साधनों का इशारा किया; पांडुलिपियाँ और चटाइयाँ भास्करवर्मन के घराने से जुड़े कारीगरों, मठों और लेखकों की कहानी कहती थीं।

panels.shot: wide shot of Harsha’s and Kamarupa’s envoys together over a map, hands indicating routes
panels.action: Envoys and counsellors from Harsha’s side and Hangsavega’s entourage bend over a map, fingers tracing routes along the Ganga and Brahmaputra, their faces serious but resolute.

dialogue.text: From this meeting grew an eastern axis. Later accounts note how Harsha and Bhaskaravarman watched Gauda together, applying pressure without erasing Shashanka’s throne.

i18n.hi: यहीं से एक पूर्वी धुरी बनी। बाद की कथाएँ बताती हैं कि हर्ष और भास्करवर्मन, दोनों मिलकर गौड़ पर नज़र रखते, दवाब डालते, पर शशांक का सिंहासन मिटाते नहीं।

panels.shot: montage-style wide showing Nalanda monastery with monks and seals being handled
panels.action: At Nalanda, monks walk through cloistered courtyards, while in the foreground a monk examines small clay seals bearing different royal emblems, laying them carefully beside one another.

dialogue.text: Years later, Nalanda’s soil yielded seals of both Harsha and Bhaskaravarman. Archaeology quietly confirmed what Bana and Xuanzang suggested: their alliance reached even into the monastic world.

i18n.hi: सालों बाद नालंदा की मिट्टी से हर्ष और भास्करवर्मन दोनों की मुहरें निकलीं। खामोश पुरातत्व ने वही बात मानो दोहरा दी, जो बाण और युवनज़ांग ने लिखी थी — उनकी संधि मठों की दुनिया तक जा पहुँची थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of Bhaskaravarman receiving a foreign monk (Xuanzang implied) in his court
panels.action: Bhaskaravarman sits graciously as a foreign monk in simple robes bows before him, attendants bringing trays of gifts and writing materials into the bright, open hall.

dialogue.text: When Xuanzang later visited Kamarupa, he recalled Bhaskaravarman’s generosity and gifts. The same king whose envoy had once crossed forests now welcomed travellers from far beyond India.

i18n.hi: जब युवनज़ांग बाद में कामरूप पहुँचा, उसने भास्करवर्मन की दरियादिली और भेंटों को याद किया। वही राजा, जिसका दूत कभी जंगलों को पार कर आया था, अब भारत से बहुत दूर के यात्रियों का स्वागत कर रहा था।

panels.shot: wide shot of Gauda’s capital in the distance, separate and unbroken
panels.action: A distant city, marked by high walls and tall towers, stands unbreached on the horizon under a brooding sky, while the foreground remains empty, no armies in motion.

dialogue.text: Shashanka did not fall at once. In the record, he still rules Gauda into the 630s. Hangsavega’s mission did not erase him; it altered how Harsha and Bhaskaravarman dealt with him.

i18n.hi: शशांक तुरंत नहीं गिरा। लिखित प्रमाणों में वह ६३० के दशक तक गौड़ पर राज करता दिखता है। हंसवेग का मिशन उसे मिटाने नहीं, बल्कि हर्ष और भास्करवर्मन का उसके साथ व्यवहार बदलने आया था।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from Bhaskaravarman standing at a balcony overlooking the Brahmaputra
panels.action: Bhaskaravarman stands on a balcony above the broad Brahmaputra at dusk, hands resting on the balustrade, watching boats move along the golden water toward the west.

dialogue.text: The alliance Hangsavega carried did not end all threats, but it joined river to river and hill to plain. It shows how a king like Bhaskaravarman could move history not only with steel, but with a spoken promise.

i18n.hi: हंसवेग की लाई संधि ने हर ख़त्म नहीं किया, पर नदी को नदी से, पहाड़ को मैदान से जोड़ दिया। यह दिखाती है कि भास्करवर्मन जैसा राजा सिर्फ़ तलवार से नहीं, बोले हुए वादे से भी इतिहास मोड़ सकता था।

subtitle_i18n.hi: जब पूर्वी पहाड़ों ने हर्ष का बुलावा सुना
